Definition: something seized, i.e. a possession (especially of land)
BiblicalUsage: A possession — achuzzah is what is seized and held, especially land. God promised Abraham the land of Canaan "for an everlasting possession"; Abraham bought a burial plot, saying, "give me a possession of a buryingplace"; and at the jubilee "ye shall return every man unto his possession." The word holds both gift and purchase, promise and homecoming.
TheologicalSignificance: The land was God's gift held in trust, and I hold that as a picture of everything we truly own: it is given, not taken, and it returns to its rightful owner in the end. Our true possession is the Lord Himself.
